name: Primary bedroom
fixed: Wall behind headboard shared with hall closet, load path unconfirmed
description: Primary bedroom in a 1980s two-story. Charcoal-gray walls, wide hand-scraped wood floor. Upholstered bed on the right wall between two nightstands with teal lamps. Large window opposite the door with gray curtains. Armchair and floor lamp by the window. One flush-mount ceiling light. TV mounted on the left wall. The wall behind the bed backs onto a hall linen closet.
